Subject: Timezone-locked demo window, Zoom bridge, and attendee clearance

Hi Avery / Priya —

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap + next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

Recap (2 mins)
- Primary goal: validate latency/cost tradeoffs for your multi-tenant inference paths and integration with your auth layer.
- Success metric: sub-200ms P95 on common prompts + end-to-end demo of our routing/fallback config.

Proposed next step: 45–60m technical deep dive (engineers + infra) to walk through a short live demo and run a sample inference.

Available slots I can host (all times PDT):
- Tue Jul 6, 10:00–11:00 PDT / 13:00–14:00 EDT
- Wed Jul 7, 08:30–09:30 PDT / 11:30–12:30 EDT
- Thu Jul 8, 15:00–16:00 PDT / 18:00–19:00 EDT

Ask: please confirm which slot works and who will join from your side (names + roles). Once you confirm I will: (1) send a calendar invite with Zoom link + passcode, (2) attach a short 30m agenda and M.A.P. draft for the PoC, and (3) add Ben (Solutions) and Marissa (Eng) as hosts.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_CNV_v1.docx (draft), demo_agenda_30m.pdf

If none of those times work, tell me two alternatives and I’ll re-propose.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
 diego@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
